'''Decisions, Decisions''' (Japanese: '''VS フリージオ''' ''VS Cryogonal''), titled '''VS Cryogonal''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 498th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 38th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}.

It is subtitled '''Cryogonal''' (Japanese: '''修業''' ''Training'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Decisions, Decisions...''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{adv|Black}} wakes up on the [[Tubeline Bridge]] and finds out what happened to him.
* Black begins his training with [[Brycen]].
* While [[Musha]], [[Tula]], and [[Costa]] train with Brycen's {{p|Vanillish}}, Black and [[Nite]] train with Brycen's {{p|Cryogonal}}.
* Black renames Nite [[Bo]].
* After some difficulty, Bo manages to defeat Brycen's Cryogonal with a {{type|Fighting}} move instead of a {{type|Fire}} move.
